meta.description: Active alerts — weather, disease, pest, market, government

data.title: Heavy Rainfall Warning
data.message: IMD warns of 100–120mm rainfall in Pune, Nashik districts over next 48 hours. Risk of waterlogging and crop damage.
data.action: Move harvested produce to dry storage; check drainage channels

data.title: Late Blight Outbreak Detected
data.message: AI scan confirms active Late Blight on farm-004 tomato beds. 42% area affected. Immediate treatment required.

data.title: Pink Bollworm Infestation
data.message: Pink bollworm density exceeding economic threshold on farms 010, 020. Pheromone trap count: 28 moths/trap/week.
data.action: Apply Chlorpyrifos 20EC; deploy additional pheromone traps

data.title: Onion Prices Drop 18%
data.message: Nashik mandi onion prices fell ₹3/kg to ₹14/kg over past week due to excess arrival. May recover post-monsoon.
data.action: Consider cold storage for 30 days; expect price recovery

data.title: Cyclone Watch: Bay of Bengal
data.message: Low-pressure system in Bay of Bengal may intensify into cyclone. Odisha, West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh coasts at risk.
data.action: Secure greenhouse infrastructure; harvest any ready produce

data.title: Cotton Root Rot Spreading
data.message: Root rot confirmed spreading on farm-015. Now covers 52% of farm area. Yield loss estimated at ₹45 lakh.
data.action: Emergency soil drench with Carbendazim; notify crop insurance

data.title: PM-KISAN 19th Installment Released
data.message: Government has released ₹2,000 per beneficiary under PM-KISAN 19th installment. Check your linked account.

data.title: Frost Advisory: Himachal Pradesh
data.message: Night temperatures may dip to 4°C in higher elevations of Shimla district this week. Protect apple orchards.
data.action: Light irrigation before frost; use anti-frost covers on young trees

data.title: Cotton MSP Increased ₹500/quintal
data.message: Government announces MSP hike for Kharif cotton 2026–27 to ₹7,521/quintal for medium staple (+₹500 YoY).

data.title: Fall Armyworm Alert – Maize
data.message: Fall armyworm sightings reported in Patna district. Monitor whorl stage plants. Economic threshold: 5% plants infested.
data.action: Apply Emamectin Benzoate 5SG @ 0.4g/L at whorl stage

data.title: Rice Blast Monitoring Alert
data.message: Blast disease conditions (high humidity + temp 26-28°C) are favourable in Chhattisgarh this week.

data.title: Heat Wave: Rajasthan, Gujarat
data.message: Temperatures 42–45°C forecast for Jodhpur, Surat districts. Increase irrigation frequency for kharif crops.
data.action: Irrigate early morning; mulch to retain soil moisture

data.title: Fasal Bima Yojana Last Date
data.message: Last date to enroll in PMFBY Kharif 2026 is 31 August. Premium: 2% for kharif crops. Enroll via CSC or bank.
data.action: Enroll before 31 Aug to secure crop insurance for ongoing season

data.title: Alphonso Mango Export Demand Surge
data.message: Dubai and Singapore buyers seeking Alphonso mango supply. Price premium of 40% over domestic market.
data.action: Register on APEDA e-platform and contact listed exporters

data.title: Locust Watch: Rajasthan Border
data.message: Desert locust monitoring active near India-Pakistan border. Rajasthan farmers advised to remain vigilant.

data.title: Whitefly Pressure Rising – Cotton
data.message: Whitefly counts (>15/leaf) observed across Vidarbha cotton belt. Conditions favour population explosion.

data.title: Good Monsoon Progress – Central India
data.message: IMD seasonal forecast: Central India rainfall is 108% of Long Period Average. Beneficial for kharif sowing.

data.title: Kisan Credit Card – 7% Interest Subvention
data.message: KCC holders get 3% interest subvention on timely repayment, reducing effective interest to 4% per annum.

data.title: Sugarcane FRP ₹345/quintal Fixed
data.message: CCEA fixes Fair and Remunerative Price for sugarcane at ₹345/quintal for 2026-27 crushing season.

data.title: Stem Borer Active – Paddy Crop
data.message: Yellow stem borer damage reported (dead-heart 8–10%) in Kaveri delta region. Immediate spray advised.
data.action: Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G @ 17kg/ha in standing water

data.title: Tea Blister Blight – Post-Rain
data.message: Post-monsoon flush susceptible to blister blight. Spray schedule must be maintained without gap.
data.action: Continue 7-day spray schedule with Copper Hydroxide 77WP

data.title: Turmeric Prices Rally ₹4,200/quintal
data.message: Erode mandi: turmeric finger prices hit ₹4,200/quintal, highest in 3 years. Good time to sell held stock.
data.action: List available stock on e-NAM; contact direct buyers in Erode
